label: Fixed-candidate replacement control with all-world contingent grounding and no reversed direct edges
paraphrase: One explicit five-candidate/two-world structural interpretation. The same candidate none actually exists and exists at both universally accessible worlds; it receives present contingent support in each. Every support edge has present endpoints, each world's present-support relation is well-founded, and every contingent candidate has a present concrete ground wherever it exists. No pair of opposite direct support edges occurs even across worlds. The necessary-only support union is empty and well-founded; no-contingent-concrete-support and all-world necessary-concrete-underivedness both fail. Concrete is uniformly stipulated. No parthood, fusion, intrinsic essence, real support adequacy or metaphysical possibility is certified.
